reasoning: Sprint 3.2 Feature Views Part 1 demonstrates strong implementation quality with comprehensive functionality across all three views. The Agents, Hierarchy, and Performance views are fully functional with real-time WebSocket integration, robust test coverage (90 tests created), and accessibility compliance. Minor issues exist around test execution readiness and some accessibility gaps, but these are non-blocking and can be addressed in backlog.
